labelled_by: Claude (draft, researched live via WebFetch/WebSearch 2026-09-27) -- NOT an independent human researcher; needs human review before being treated as frozen ground truth.
rules: Label only what the website states. No outside knowledge. Copy quotes exactly. If pages disagree, record both as conflicting. If the site does not say, use not_found.
review_notes: customers.industries left not_found because Temenos' site frames banking sub-segments (retail, corporate, wealth, Islamic, credit unions) as customer segments, not a list of distinct served industries outside banking -- treated those instead under customers.segments. Headquarters found only as 'Geneva, Switzerland' on the temenos.com/ai-info/ page; the offices/contact pages list many office cities but never label one as HQ (only the legal-entity name 'Temenos Headquarters SA' appears in the footer). pricing.sales_motion marked 'inferred' since it is deduced from the absence of self-serve pricing and presence of 'Get in Touch' contact forms, not a stated sentence. Certifications limited to SOC 2 and ISO/IEC 27001, which the security page states are held; excluded analyst recognitions (Gartner, Forrester, Euromoney, CNBC) as awards, and excluded CSA CCM as a self-assessment matrix, not a certification. IBM was mentioned as a partner in an initial homepage summary but no verbatim on-site quote could be confirmed, so it was dropped from traction.partnerships. B-51 (2026-09-27): customers.segments was previously marked 'inferred', but this field is not on this project's INFERENCE_WHITELIST (wi/schemas/claim.py), making that status structurally unmatchable by the pipeline regardless of extraction quality -- corrected to 'extracted' since the homepage segment-navigation labels (Retail & Business, Corporate & Commercial, Wealth Management, Credit Unions & Community, Islamic Banking) are genuine short quotable labels, not an inference; evidence updated to those exact labels as an array, matching the array-evidence convention used elsewhere for multi-item quoted lists.
